threshold_policy.selection: Fixed at DeepSlide documented default (sigmoid > 0.5). Not tuned on the evaluation set.
threshold_policy.scientific_note: Raw sigmoid outputs are uncalibrated segmentation scores, not risk probabilities.

held_out_eval.dataset: Landslide4Sense validation split (HF mirror with masks)
held_out_eval.rationale: DeepSlide trained on Landslide4Sense; public train chips are leakage-prone. Validation split is the competition held-out set with labels on HF mirrors.

absolute_micro_f1_floor.rationale: Floor below official IARAI U-Net validation F1 0.5782 to allow smaller subsample variance; not a claim of matching the leaderboard.

scientific_acceptance.policy: Even if numeric gates pass, scientific_acceptance remains UNRESOLVED unless an independent spatially blocked inventory study is completed. This milestone does not claim scientific validation.

rules: Input stack must include 14 bands in L4S order with documented provenance
Output GeoTIFF must carry a real CRS (not None) and affine matching the input window
Do not invent CRS for L4S HDF5 chips
Do not map SSRI 13-channel stack into 14 bands

required_checks: compare against unknown Render RAM with conservative 512MB-class caution
deployment.pass_rule: Single-chip CPU inference completes; peak RSS for model+one chip < 1500 MB; no claim of verified production deploy without live Render test
